lines.text: Look at Shiva's throat. Why is it blue?

parts.text: Look at Shiva's throat.
Why is it blue?

lines.text: Something is still trapped in there.

parts.text: Something is still trapped in there.

lines.text: Gods and demons once churned the ocean together, for the nectar that ends death.

parts.text: Gods and demons once churned the ocean together,
for the nectar that ends death.

lines.text: They pulled for a thousand years.

parts.text: They pulled for a thousand years.

lines.text: But nectar did not come first.

parts.text: But nectar did not come first.

lines.text: Poison did. Halahala. Enough to burn the three worlds to nothing.

parts.text: Poison did.
Halahala.
Enough to burn the three worlds to nothing.

lines.text: The gods ran. The demons ran. Nobody wanted the first gift of their own work.

parts.text: The gods ran. The demons ran.
Nobody wanted the first gift of their own work.

lines.text: Shiva gathered it in his palm, and drank.

parts.text: Shiva gathered it in his palm,
and drank.

lines.text: Parvati caught his throat with both hands. If it went down, it would destroy him. If it came out, it would destroy the world.

parts.text: Parvati caught his throat with both hands.
If it went down, it would destroy him.
If it came out, it would destroy the world.

lines.text: So it stays there. Forever. Held, and never swallowed.

parts.text: So it stays there.
Forever.
Held, and never swallowed.

lines.text: Some pain you cannot throw at the world, and you must not take into your heart. You hold it. That is sadhana.
